The lagged version reported by the "same" respondent is m5k10a, which is not in our feature set because it has the warning "Misordered Categorical (outcomes do not have a contstant scale)" [SIC]

Note that it seems like f5k10a should have this same warning, but it doesn't. At this point I don't think we should do further metadata edits, since that would require backtracking on the search for lagged measures in the feature set. Also, I think some nonlinear models would do fine with misordered categorical features, but I think we should maintain our original decision to drop these features since changing it now would require backtracking on the search for lagged measures in the feature set, and could introduce unexpected new issues.

Note that the youth made reports at wave 5 about the mom's use of various types of discipline; however, this does not meet our definition of being a lagged measure, because the respondent is different.
